variants.label: DateTime Picker
variants.tooltip: Provides a calendar from which the user can select the date and time.

variants.label: Date and Time
variants.tooltip: Provides a calendar from which the user can select the date and time.

variants.label: Date
variants.tooltip: Provides a calendar from which the user can select the date and time.

value.description: Current date/time as a Date object or timestamp in milliseconds

formattedValue.description: Date and time in configured format

pickerType.description: Whether to display and enable picker for date only, or both date and time

minDate.description: Minimum date/time as a Date object or timestamp in milliseconds. If null, the minimum date is 10 years in the past from today.

maxDate.description: Maximum date/time as a Date object or timestamp in milliseconds. If null, the maximum date is 10 years in the future from today.

format.description: Template for formatting date display - must be valid moment.js format, e.g. 'MM/DD/YYYY h:mm a'

locale.description: Code for localization of language and formatting

enabled.description: False will disable any interaction with calendar

events.name: onActionPerformed
events.description: This event is fired when the 'action' of the component occurs.
